source: INFORM SADC 2024 workbook, sheet 'Metadata' (indicators in use)

HA.NAT.CH-ERO.name: Coastal Erosion
HA.NAT.CH-ERO.description: A continental dataset that includes annual shorelines and rates of coastal change along the entire African coastline. Generated for 2000 to 2023. Combines satellite data from the Digital Earth Africa program with tidal modelling to map the typical location of the coastline at mean sea level each yea

HA.NAT.DR-FRE.name: Historic Drought Frequency
HA.NAT.DR-FRE.description: Historic Agricultural Drought Frequency Maps depict the frequency of severe drought in areas where 30 percent/50 percent of the cropland/grassland has been affected. The historical frequency of severe droughts (as defined by ASI) is based on the entire ASI times series (1984-2023).

HA.NAT.EQ-EXP.name: Earthquake exposure
HA.NAT.EQ-EXP.description: The Global Earthquake Model (GEM) Global Seismic Hazard Map (version 2023.1) depicts the geographic distribution of the Peak Ground Acceleration (PGA) with a 10% probability of being exceeded in 50 years, computed for reference rock conditions (shear wave velocity, Vs30, of 760-800 m/s)

HA.NAT.ED-DEF.name: Deforestation - Treecover Loss
HA.NAT.ED-DEF.description: Deforestation derived from global forest watch data. Input data is derived from Landsat (approx 30m resolution). Tree cover is defined as cannopy closure for all vegetation taller than 5m. For detail of input datasets see https://data.globalforestwatch.org/documents/941f17325a494ed78c4817f9bb20f33a/

HA.NAT.DE-ERO.name: Soil Erosion
HA.NAT.DE-ERO.description: Soil erosion defined as the difference between natural soil erosion and actual soil erosion globally.

HA.NAT.FL-EXP.name: Flood exposure
HA.NAT.FL-EXP.description: Data set representing inundation along the river network, for seven different flood return periods (from 1-in-10-years to 1-in-500-years). 1 in 100 year was chosen for analysis. Input data values provide flood depth in metres. This was simplified to include any depth of flooding, from which we calac

HA.NAT.LS-EXP.name: Landslide exposure
HA.NAT.LS-EXP.description: Qualitative representation of global landslide hazard at a global scale. Dataset used combines the median annual rainfall triggered landslide hazard with earthquake hazard triggerd, simplifying it into 4 ranks from very low to high

HA.NAT.ST-TC2.name: Cyclone exposure - max speed
HA.NAT.ST-TC2.description: Datasets containing tropical cyclone maximum wind speed (in m/s) return periods. For full description see https://data.4tu.nl/datasets/0ea98bdd-5772-4da8-ae97-99735e891aff/4

HA.NAT.VC-EXP.name: Volcano exposure
HA.NAT.VC-EXP.description: Data from the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), displays global locations of significant volcanic eruptions. Conatins value for Volcanic Explosivity Index (VEI)

HA.NAT.WF-BURN.name: Burned Area
HA.NAT.WF-BURN.description: Global dataset of individual fire perimeters for 2002-2023, provided as polygon features.

HA.NAT.WF-FWI.name: Fire Weather Index
HA.NAT.WF-FWI.description: Computed from five components. The first three components are numeric ratings of the moisture content of litter and other fine fuels, the average moisture content of loosely compacted organic layers of moderate depth, and the average moisture content of deep, compact organic layers. The last two com

HA.HUM.CI-CBAR.name: Conflict Barometer
HA.HUM.CI-CBAR.source: Heidelberg Institute for International Conflict Research
HA.HUM.CI-CBAR.description: The HIIK's annual publication Conflict Barometer describes the recent trends in global conflict developments, escalations, de-escalations, and settlements.

HA.HUM.CR-GCRI.name: GCRI derived Conflict probability
HA.HUM.CR-GCRI.description: The Global Conflict Risk Index (GCRI) estimates the risk of internal conflict at the country level within the next 4 years. INFORM Risk uses the GCRI probability estimates for the “any conflict” category, which includes the sub-categories “state-based conflict”, “non-state conflict”, and “one-sided

HA.HUM.VIO-EVE.name: Number of Events
HA.HUM.VIO-EVE.description: ACLED (Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project) is the most comprehensive public collection of political violence data for developing states. This dataset contains information on the specific dates and locations of political violence, the types of event, the groups involved, fatalities and chan

HA.HUM.VIO-FAT.name: Number of Fatalities
HA.HUM.VIO-FAT.description: ACLED (Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project) is the most comprehensive public collection of political violence data for developing states. This dataset contains information on the specific dates and locations of political violence, the types of event, the groups involved, fatalities and chan

VU.SE.POV-HDI.name: Human Development Index
VU.SE.POV-HDI.description: The Human Development Index measure development by combining indicators of life expectancy, educational attainment and income into a composite index.

VU.SE.POV-GDI.name: Gender Development Index
VU.SE.POV-GDI.description: The GDI measures gender gaps in achievements in three basic dimensions of human development: health (measured by female and male life expectancy at birth), knowledge (measured by female and male expected years of schooling for children and mean years of schooling for adults aged 25 years and older)

VU.SE.POV-MPI.name: Multidimensional Poverty Index
VU.SE.POV-MPI.description: The Multidimensional Poverty MPI Index identifies overlapping deprivations at the household level across the same three dimensions as the Human Development Index (living standards, health, and education) and shows the average number of poor people and deprivations with which poor households contend.

VU.SE.DEP-ODA.name: Net ODA received (% of GNI)
VU.SE.DEP-ODA.description: Net official development assistance (ODA) consists of disbursements of loans made on concessional terms (net of repayments of principal) and grants by official agencies of the members of the Development Assistance Committee (DAC), by multilateral institutions, and by non-DAC countries to promote eco

VU.SE.DEP-REM.name: Personal remittances
VU.SE.DEP-REM.description: Personal transfers consist of all current transfers in cash or in kind made or received by resident households to or from nonresident households. Personal transfers thus include all current transfers between resident and nonresident individuals. Compensation of employees refers to the income of bord

VU.SE.DEP-DR.name: Dependency Ratio
VU.SE.DEP-DR.description: Dependency ratio, dependend population compared to the working age population (15-64)

VU.SE.HAB-INF.name: Population in informal settlements
VU.SE.HAB-INF.description: The share of urban population living in slum households, based on 4 out of 5 household shelter deprivations defined by UN-Habitat as indicators of informality: lack of access to improved water, lack of access to improved sanitation, lack of sufficient living area and quality/durability of structure.

VU.SE.HAB-URB.name: Urban Population
VU.SE.HAB-URB.description: % of population living in urban areas in region

VU.SE.LV-FS.name: Food Security - Insufficient food
VU.SE.LV-FS.description: Population at IPC level 2 or above

VU.VG.DP-IDP.name: Internal Displaced People
VU.VG.DP-IDP.description: Internally displaced persons - IDPs refers to the number of people living in displacement as of the end of each year. It covers both confllict and disaster IDP's

VU.VG.HC-MALAPREV.name: Malaria prevalence
VU.VG.HC-MALAPREV.description: Proportion of children 2 to 10 years with malaria infection for a given year

VU.VG.CH-MORTNEO.name: Neonatal mortality
VU.VG.CH-MORTNEO.description: Number of neonates dying before 28 days of age, per 1,000 live births in a given year

VU.VG.CH-MORTINF.name: Infant mortality
VU.VG.CH-MORTINF.description: Number of deaths of children less than one year of age, per 1000 live births in a given year

VU.VG.CH-MORTCH.name: Child mortality
VU.VG.CH-MORTCH.description: Number of children dying between 1 year of age and five year of age, per 1,000 live births in a given year

VU.VG.CH-UW.name: Children Underweight
VU.VG.CH-UW.description: Percentage of children aged 0-59 months who are below minus two standard deviations from median weight-for-age of the World Health Organization (WHO) Child Growth Standards

CC.INF.HC-EXP.name: Health expenditure per capita
CC.INF.HC-EXP.description: Per capita total expenditure on health (THE) expressed in Purchasing Power Parities (PPP) international dollar.

CC.INF.HC-BCG.name: BCG Immunization Coverage
CC.INF.HC-BCG.description: Percentage of children aged 1 who received a BCG vaccination

CC.INF.HC-DTP.name: DTP3 Immunization Coverage
CC.INF.HC-DTP.description: Percentage of children aged 1 who received a DTP3 vaccination

CC.INF.HC-MEASLES.name: Measles Immunization Coverage
CC.INF.HC-MEASLES.description: Percentage of children aged 1 who received a measles vaccination

CC.INF.HC-PHY.name: Physicians density
CC.INF.HC-PHY.description: Number of medical doctors (physicians), including generalist and specialist medical practitioners, per 10,000 population.

CC.INF.HC-FAC.name: Density of health facilities
CC.INF.HC-FAC.description: Density of health facilities per capita. The HDX database of health facilities was developed from a variety of government and non-government sources from 50 countries in sub-Saharan Africa. It uses multiple geocoding methods to provide a comprehensive spatial inventory of 98 745 public health facili

CC.INF.ECO-INC.name: Household income
CC.INF.ECO-INC.description: Household income is a measure of the combined incomes of all people sharing a particular household or place of residence

CC.INF.ECO-IWI.name: International Wealth Index
CC.INF.ECO-IWI.description: The international Wealth Index is an asset-based wealth index that runs from 0 (no assets) to 100 (all assets) and is comparable across place and time

CC.INF.ECO-GDP.name: Gross National Income per capita
CC.INF.ECO-GDP.description: Log Gross National Income per capita in thousands of US Dollars (2011 PPP).

CC.INF.WASH-SAN.name: People using at least basic sanitation services (% of population)
CC.INF.WASH-SAN.source: WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme (JMP) for Water Supply and Sanitation
CC.INF.WASH-SAN.description: The percentage of people using at least basic sanitation services, that is, improved sanitation facilities that are not shared with other households. This indicator encompasses both people using basic sanitation services as well as those using safely managed sanitation services. Improved sanitation

CC.INF.WASH-WF.name: People using at least basic drinking water services (% of population)
CC.INF.WASH-WF.source: WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme (JMP) for Water Supply and Sanitation
CC.INF.WASH-WF.description: The percentage of people using at least basic water services. This indicator encompasses both people using basic water services as well as those using safely managed water services. Basic drinking water services is defined as drinking water from an improved source, provided collection time is not mo

CC.INF.COM-ELEC.name: Access to electricity
CC.INF.COM-ELEC.description: Percentage of households with electricity in region

CC.INF.COM-INT.name: Internet access
CC.INF.COM-INT.description: Percentage of households with internet access in region

CC.INF.COM-PHONE.name: Cellphone ownership
CC.INF.COM-PHONE.description: Percentage of households with a cellphone in region

CC.INF.EDU-ALIT.name: Adult literacy rate
CC.INF.EDU-ALIT.description: Total is the percentage of the population age 15 and above who can, with understanding, read and write a short, simple statement on their everyday life.

CC.INF.EDU-YRS.name: Mean years at school
CC.INF.EDU-YRS.description: Mean years schooling of population 25+. The mean years of schooling of adults aged 25+ (MYS), reflects the current situation with regard to education in a society. Mean years of schooling was computed by using the Global Data Lab Area Database, taking for each region the average number of years of e

CC.INS.DRR-SEN.name: Sendai Framework for Action
CC.INS.DRR-SEN.description: Score of adoption and implementation of national strategies for managing disaster risk, 2023. Score from 0 (worst) to 1 (best) measuring alignment of country disaster risk reduction strategies with the Sendai Framework.

CC.INS.DRR-EWS.name: Early Warning System
CC.INS.DRR-EWS.description: Number of people targeted by Anticipatory Action frameworks in 2023

CC.INS.GOV-EFF.name: Government effectiveness
CC.INS.GOV-EFF.description: The Government effectiveness captures perceptions of the quality of public services, the quality of the civil service and the degree of its independence from political pressures, the quality of policy formulation and implementation, and the credibility of the government's commitment to such policies

CC.INS.GOV-SCI.name: Subnational Corruption Index
CC.INS.GOV-SCI.description: The Subnational Corruption Database (SCD) provides data on corruption in 1,473 subnational areas of 178 countries.
